## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible change and link the Issue/proposal for behavior changes.

## Validation

List actual commands, platform, results and unverified cases. For UI changes attach
synthetic screenshots and describe browser interactions, including failure paths.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Focused change; applicable proposal, specs and migration notes are updated.
- [ ] Relevant failure and partial-failure paths were checked.
- [ ] No credentials, real content, raw logs, operational data or private deployment information.
- [ ] Third-party licenses and notices are preserved where applicable.
